title: Function-approximation laboratory
summary: Linear TD(λ) with state aggregation on the 19-state walk; coarse coding of a square wave (Example 9.1); the asymptotic error of linear TD(λ) against the best possible, computed exactly (9.9); and the mountain-car task with tile coding and linear Sarsa(λ), with its cost-to-go and the α–λ–trace study of Figure 9.11.
guide: Linear TD(λ): with group size 1 the method is tabular; with larger groups the approximation becomes a staircase that cannot match the straight true line exactly.
Coarse coding: compare narrow and broad features after 40 examples (very different shapes), then after 10,240 (nearly the same).
Bound: the ratio of TD(λ)'s error to the best possible is far below (1 − γλ)/(1 − γ); λ = 1 reaches the best exactly; try γ = 0.99.
Mountain car: train 100 episodes. The steps per episode fall from hundreds to under 100; the cost-to-go shows the spiral the car must follow.
The α–λ study (slow): accumulating traces fail at larger α with λ = 0.9; replacing traces stay robust.
